notes.title: Surprise! Relaxing Kite is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]
Relaxing Kite has just been released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215846/5914c70dc55413900accd3407b85486f948c8ef5.png[/img]

Wait! Pause for a moment and immerse yourself in some relaxing entertainment. Sit back, put on your headphones, and relax. The unique audiovisual experience will allow you to finally cut yourself off from everything and enjoy the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215846/7bdb5a815fbab6106a921b5bd91e31b023a44b6a.png[/img]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*]new maps
[*]new kites
[*]new characters
[*]new colors
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215846/eae2ef7624392a97e5b8b54fa16682403ee55b9a.png[/img]
